claims.text: Slack's Aug 20 changelog states Slack Code creates dedicated channels from existing conversations where agents and people build together, publishing code diffs, Block Kit views, HTML previews, and canvases.
Live at launch for Claude, Devin, GitHub Copilot, and Vercel integrations (ChatGPT soon); sessions archive on completion with audit logs.
